evals.prompt: hey i need a landing page for docpilotai — it's 29.99 a month, apple pay only. domain is docpilotai.com. can you put together the ticket for the cc team?
evals.expected_output: A ticket in Block A / Block B form with the four given values filled, everything else marked TBC with an owner, and a blockers list. No page built.
assertions: Output is structured as a ticket with a shared Block A section and a per-slug Block B section
Unknown fields are explicitly marked TBC rather than left blank or silently invented
The Apple Pay merchant identifier is flagged as a blocker and is NOT copied from another product's page
Google Pay is explicitly recorded as disabled rather than simply omitted
A blockers list names who owns each missing item
The response does not attempt to create the page or operate panel.ouisys.com

evals.prompt: adding 3 new slugs to smartpdfdesk. cc_acquired-smartpdfdesk2999_001-de (one off 29.99), cc_acquired-smartpdfdesk1999_002-de (one off 19.99), cc_acquired-smartpdfdesk999_003-de (one off 9.99). all on smartpdfdesk.com, bank id 88, apple pay and google pay both on. need the ticket for these please
evals.expected_output: Ticket with one Block A and three Block B rows; the -de suffix caught and corrected; one-off trial price set equal to the price on every row.
assertions: The trailing -de country suffix is identified as wrong on all three slugs
Corrected slugs are shown ending at the hyphen with no country code
Plan type is recorded as one-off for all three rows
Trial price equals the full price on every one-off row (guarding the 0.01 default)
Billing cycle and trial days are zero for the one-off rows
Block A appears once and is not duplicated per slug
Google Pay is recorded as enabled, matching what the requester asked for
